expectations.evidence: Report is scoped to COHORT_BASED_COURSE. Lists ProgramDetails fields in a table, analyzes program-form.tsx, identifies 6 missing form fields.
Full field-by-field table of ProgramDetails (18 fields). Identifies 6 fields missing from the form. Analyzes enum mismatches specific to ProgramDetails (interaction_type, community_platform).
No marketing framework is referenced by name. No mention of Hormozi, WbD, Casel, Brunson, or any other framework. The audit is purely code-structural, not methodology-driven.
No Product Blueprint or Ficha Tecnica validation. The report is organized by code gaps (specific_details not in template, enum mismatches, missing form fields) not by methodology requirements.
Lists what SDR receives vs doesn't receive, but doesn't structure this as program-specific questions. No explicit questions like 'When does the program start?' or 'How many spots are left?'
No brand-to-offer inheritance analysis. The report doesn't mention brand voice, story, positioning, or proof inheritance at all.
